text.p: Following are the main stories in Wednesday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
All dailies lead with the death of Proton chairman Yahaya Ahmad and his wide and pilot in a helicopter crash on Monday.

-- As the Department of Civil Aviation scrambled to unravel the cause of the helicopter crash that killed Proton chairman Yahaya Ahmad on Monday, thousands thronged his home town to pay their respects.
-- Villagers said they heard a mid-air explosion seconds before the crash of Yahaya's Italian-made Agusta 109 helicopter.
-- Deputy Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim assured investors the government would continue to support DRB-Hicom group's projects.

-- Telekom Malaysia Bhd announced on Tuesday it is in the final rounds of negotiations to jointly acquire with U.S. based SBC International Inc, a 30 percent stake in Telkom S.A., the South African telecommunications monopoly.
